title: Authenticate same-build generated GCC data and record guarded directives
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Supplies actual generated GCC plugin-header/configuration data tied to the exact installed GCC build by matching SHA256/size rows in retained changes and buildinfo, plus bounded ar/control/directive parsers. The view records 21 ordered tm.h includes, 11 guarded distro defaults, five configure-default entries and a38-member/38-edge literal graph.

This is an individually completed prerequisite component in the original compiler-input closure and the full named bootstrap-control campaign assignment. **Complete compiler-input closure, complete bootstrap-control campaign, effective configuration, original execution and runtime qualification remain open.** No performance or κ gain is claimed.

## Task and overlap

Original source investigation: [PR #6321](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6321). Frozen H25 benchmark: [PR #6029](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6029). Immediate predecessors: [PR #6362](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6362), [PR #6363](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6363).

Task-card scope is changed to this concrete code increment; the user-assigned original compiler-input closure and the full bootstrap-control campaign completion criteria are unchanged. Base `7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a`; published head `97dd394ce1ddf00cc80dfdaad71767fdbc85af47`; tree `8ccf73c9a29e66c0f91d3ef535f57abb19600d61` matches byte-checked local commit `4a1577e41acf254bef52bfadbfcffca42bc9159d`. 535 new files, one commit.

Canonical investigation #6321. #6362 (`120072d58ddb46f0e02886756243174d41fce42e`) provides the earlier partial input-edge/source/data helpers. #6363 (`a8cf650b7435ccea237084e491e339f725c0a35b`) provides exact parent/domain compatibility findings and the bounded related-PR graph. This adds the reviewed implementation and cold inputs for its named scope; it does not replace the original activity with a finite test.

## Validation

Executed locally with Python 3.12:

```sh
python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/h25-gcc-generated-config-data --check-only
python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/h25-gcc-generated-config-data
python3 scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/h25-gcc-generated-config-data
```

29 new pure controls passed in normal Python and -O. Independent Sol Max source/delta review accepted the bounded recorder after fixing archive-offset variable clobber and forged embedded-report provenance; cross-export and documentation-delta review passed. The packet contains all 472 pinned headers, the exact 1,451,870-byte raw package, build/embedded/compiler-member reports, preserved rejected sources, and licenses.

Registered replay uses only new code and committed inert source/data inputs. No original module, Root/provider/parent, compiler/native target, namespace or scientific workload runs. Actual hosted checks will be recorded after submission, bound to this exact head.

The recorder preserves conditions without evaluating them. One angle-include edge, cpplib.h, remains unresolved rather than classified absent. Final installed-stage driver/preprocessor/prefix definitions, specs, multilib and option initializers remain open after a retained HTTP503 build-log failure. No decoder, acquisition or installed compiler executes in registered replay. The already-correct v1 acquisition report is distinguished from the defective pre-review parser code; v2 metadata is not called fresh decoding.

The source unit closed at 09:42:53 UTC on 2026-11-02; its sole repair window remained inside the fixed hour. Publication adapters/checks are separate. No original budget expanded: recorded guard debit 94.550533479/2400 is not full physical cost; preparation/review/publication/final costs remain OPEN_NOT_ZERO. App goal separately observed paused.

## Credit

Copied GCC/generated headers retain GNU notices, GPL3 and Runtime Library Exception texts. New original parser/glue is Apache-2.0. Checksums/publisher association do not imply signature verification, regeneration or installed semantic equivalence.

Chris R/Clear1nsight with substantial ChatGPT Pro/Codex/Sol Max implementation and independent agent source/export review. Retain original authors, PR6321/6029/5864 lineage, unpaidmoon/Cursor Grok for PR #6339 and Douglas R. Colkitt's native/circuit/verification lineage. Agent and finite-test acceptance remains distinct from human, proof-kernel and original qualification.

## Open next questions

See the package README. Complete actual configured/query-producing rules, witness closure and immutable interval; integrate the separately reviewed operand/context and prefix components with the authentic parent/control route; preserve all original caps, raw first-error ownership and stage/command/funding/execution gates. A further Pro consultation is auditing coverage by construction as a conditional alternative; no changed instance, native policy or assurance premise is adopted by this PR.
